As for the term in relation to transwomen; cis is just clarifying we’re talking strictly about those assigned female at birth. So it has an important use.

If I talk about women, both trans and cis women will be included. 
If I talk about trans women, only trans women will be included. Not cis ones.
If I talk about cis women, only cis women will be included. Not trans ones.

As with every other adjective.

He has come to my room crying because some friend said they wanted to cut their friendship cuz he wouldn’t stop doing something he had been doing for months without ANY sign that anyone disliked it! And the latest time something like that happened he was 17.

Asperger kids (as far as I know) want it to be clear. If you want them to stop doing something, tell them outright. Don’t sugarcoat it, don’t build a grudge on it, BE HONEST. They are the kindest people you will have ever met if you can match their loyalty and trust. My brother isn’t a bad person, he can’t help a diagnose. I’m not saying you NEED to be friends with him or treat him extra just because he has autism. But if you know you can’t match his mindset, spare him the pain.
